title: Crystal Clear Bar Salts Blue Slush Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Crystal Clear Blue Slush Nic Salt brings together sweet Blueberry and a brisk Ice finish to recreate the flavour of a classic blue slushy. The Blueberry delivers a rich, juicy flavour, while the cooling exhale gives the blend its signature frozen twist. It's a chilled-out all-day vape for fruit and menthol fans. This Nic Salt is blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with pod kits and vape pens. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths for a smooth throat hit and quick nicotine absorption. Crystal Clear Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same great-tasting flavours that made disposable vapes so popular, now reimagined for refillable pod kits. Designed for clarity, consistency and convenience, this UK-made range focuses on fruity, icy, and confectionery-inspired blends that cater to everyday vapers.
